title: Claude designs protein binders for 15 targets
summary: After an initial prompt, Claude selected binding sites, used design and folding models, and chose candidates, with success on 14 of 15 targets. Of 1,320 designs, 354 bound, for rates of 22–35% versus a typical 10–15%. None of the 90 designs for the maltose-binding protein worked. External labs ran the tests.

evidence.tested: External labs (Adaptyv Bio and Twist Bioscience) produced and tested the designs: 354 of 1,320 designs bound, with hit rates of 22-35% versus a typical 10-15%; none of 90 designs for maltose-binding protein bound.
evidence.unknown: Anthropic plans further characterization to confirm hit rates and affinities; BBF-14 affinities are modest, GDF-8 data were inconclusive and excluded, and the TNFa result is unexplained.
evidence.ai_role: Claude chose binding sites, generated candidate structures and sequences by orchestrating structure, sequence and co-folding models, ran in silico optimization and chose candidates.
